sources.topic: TP save/load/clear forms, recursive references, kind/protection selection, free-space hints and existing-file behavior

contract.representation: Versioned portable JSON logical TP records, typed positions and TP-local numeric/string/position registers; internal program identity retained
contract.dependencies: Explicit bounded case-insensitive calls graph; iterative cycle/shared-node traversal, known macro targets excluded, COPY_TPE copies detached graph metadata
contract.selection: Portable PBR constants filter TP/JB/PR/MR records; VR/PC-only forms unsupported; backup protected flag and clear skip behavior
contract.guards: Selected/open/bound/protected/active/source identities prevent writes; archive changes refresh explicit load flags and preserve overlay attributes
contract.files: Exact MemoryFiles/DeviceFiles; whole-batch preflight with quotas/retained garbage/free-space hints; unchanged backups skip writes
contract.restore: Existing programs retained with live dependency graph; complete validation before new records/files are published
contract.persistence: Optional graph/budget and logical records/file bytes round-trip; legacy default fields stay unchanged

boundaries: No native TP/PC/VR/IO binary support or ordinary KAREL variable snapshots
No source code unloading, instruction parsing/execution, selected/caller/handle restoration or controller access
Exact in-memory backends only; no DirectoryFiles/custom callbacks or host filesystem access
Whole-batch preflight differs from native partial progress; strict mode and native status parity deferred
